hooks fixture

Each group holds a progress bar, a checkbox, and a link. The first sets no hook, the second sets --accent-color on its subtree, and the third sets --interaction-color on its subtree. The fourth sets no hook inside a palette and scheme scope of its own. The probes read the palette's --magenta and --blue as a color, at the root and inside the scope.
